articles.summary: Montana Governor Greg Gianforte and Department of Labor & Industry (DLI) Commissioner Sarah Swanson announced a $325,000 grant for a pilot program to hire and train veterans living with disabilities to operate heavy construction equipment from a remote and accessible location.
articles.title: Expanding Opportunities for Veterans With Disabilities: Collaboration with Montana, Knife River, Teleo, RDO Equipment, and John Deere
